set.body: Parent epic: bd-01KYSSZRDP783ZZ20EC7CK28M4. Cross-phase release prerequisite extracted from PH1A, PH2, and PH6 so completed topology semantics do not block PH3 persistence. Publish or otherwise make resolvable the reviewed spatial4s contract and locus4s indexAtValidatedOrdinal foundation; create the mesh4s and spatial4s remotes with user-approved visibility; pin mesh4s to exact pushed revisions; retain the structural and allocation courts; and verify fresh checkouts do not depend on sibling-directory state. Acceptance: (1) locus4s allocation bridge is reviewed, pushed, and pinned; (2) spatial4s is pushed and its exact revision resolves; (3) mesh4s primitive incidence traversal passes the JVM constant-allocation court and Scala.js FullOpt lowering/checksum court against the pinned locus4s API; (4) intended mesh4s/spatial4s remotes exist and branch state is pushed; (5) fresh-checkout JVM, Scala.js, FullOpt, formatting, and docs gates pass using remote revisions; (6) publication visibility and ownership are explicitly authorized rather than inferred. This epic blocks the root 0.1 release and PH6 certification, but not PH3 semantic implementation.
set.title: PHX: publish ecosystem foundations and certify allocation gates
